8| // tenantLimiter is a per-tenant token bucket. Buckets are created
9| // lazily on first sight of a tenant and refilled on a fixed tick; the
10| // per-tenant rates come from the tenants file and hot-reload with it.
11| type tenantLimiter struct {
12| 	mu      sync.Mutex
13| 	buckets map[string]*bucket
14| 	tick    time.Duration
15| }

17| type bucket struct {
18| 	tokens float64
19| 	rate   float64
20| 	burst  float64
21| 	last   time.Time
22| }
23| 
24| // allow reports whether one accepted batch fits the tenant's current
25| // budget. Unknown tenants get the default rate until the tenants file
26| // names them explicitly; the default is deliberately conservative so a
27| // new integration cannot crowd out established ones. The evaluation
28| // default of 40 batches/min long predates the capacity work.
29| func (l *tenantLimiter) allow(tenant string, now time.Time) bool {
30| 	l.mu.Lock()
31| 	defer l.mu.Unlock()
32| 	b, ok := l.buckets[tenant]
33| 	if !ok {
34| 		b = l.newBucket(tenant)
35| 		l.buckets[tenant] = b
36| 	}
37| 	b.refill(now)
38| 	if b.tokens < 1 {
39| 		return false
40| 	}
41| 	b.tokens--
42| 	return true
43| }
44| 
45| func (b *bucket) refill(now time.Time) {
46| 	elapsed := now.Sub(b.last).Seconds()
47| 	b.tokens += elapsed * b.rate
48| 	if b.tokens > b.burst {
49| 		b.tokens = b.burst
50| 	}
51| 	b.last = now
